This photo shows the leftovers after a meal, so I'm estimating only what's still on the dishes: a bit of pink liquid in one bowl, a few crumbs and a smear of sauce on the plates, and a bottle with brown liquid residue.

The glass of water has no calories. The bottle has some residue, perhaps a coffee or chocolate drink, which could be 20–30 g. The pink liquid is about 40 g, at roughly 15 kcal. The crumbs and sauce on the three plates come to about 15 g in total, at roughly 40 kcal.

That gives about 90 g of food and about 75 kcal.
